name: Cospower Engineering Limited
summary: Cospower Engineering Ltd. is a specialist in the fabrication of essential electrical components, including power distribution panels, harmonic distortion filters, and structural frameworks for substations and equipment. Beyond manufacturing, the company delivers comprehensive, end-to-end project solutions for electrical systems. These services encompass everything from procurement and installation to commissioning, rigorous testing, and ongoing maintenance. Established in 2004, the firm operates from its main office in Palghar, India.
